name: Prof. Ananya Singh
buyer_profile: Free tier on personal account, sometimes Pro
goals: Build a research data collection and analysis pipeline
Create a literature review tool that summarizes papers
Deploy a survey platform for student experiments
communication_style: Methodical, precise, references academic standards, asks about reproducibility and data privacy (IRB compliance)
pain_points: Survey tools cost too much on academic budgets
Data analysis is trapped in SPSS, need modern alternatives
Research tools need to be explainable to non-technical colleagues
sample_prompts: Build a research survey platform with randomized question ordering, consent forms, and CSV export for SPSS
Create a tool that takes a list of paper abstracts and generates a structured literature review with themes and gaps
Build a longitudinal data collection system for tracking student performance across a semester with statistical analysis
